checks.detail: Deterministic package validation passed after aligning the submission owner, proposal author metadata, schema contract, and Git blob hashes.
All nine concept geometry layers are present and use the organizer provisional boundary; three non-blocking provenance issues remain disclosed.
Bilingual A3/A0 drawings and the static offline visual dashboard are packaged without external runtime dependencies.
The bilingual proposal links standards, design-depth items, metrics, geometry, assumptions, and registered sources.

caveats: The overall boundary and three key areas are provisional organizer constraints, not an official redline.
Spatial metrics must be recalculated if official geometry is released.
